scope: Round 13 Xbox-generation software, game decompilation, recompilation, and decompilation-based ports. Status statements are attributed to maintainers; project and game data remain user-supplied where stated.

projects.title: Xbox Recompilation Toolkit (Original Xbox)
projects.platform: Original Xbox XBE → native x86-64 C executables; the v0.14.0 release adds evolving Linux, macOS, and arm64 host/runtime support
projects.status: v0.14.0 was published on 2026-10-16. The maintainer README says this repository builds title-neutral runtime libraries and tools; it does not produce a complete game executable by itself. Each game executable is generated in a separate title-specific project from user-supplied game files.
projects.summary: A title-agnostic static recompilation toolkit for Original Xbox XBE binaries. It lifts x86 instructions to C and provides Xbox kernel, graphics, audio, and input runtime libraries; game projects link those libraries and compile the generated code locally. This is a recompilation toolchain, not an emulator or a game-specific port.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; original game data is supplied by the user

projects.title: ReXGlue SDK — Xbox 360 Recompilation Runtime and Toolkit
projects.platform: Xbox 360 PowerPC → portable C++ native projects; host support depends on the evolving shared runtime
projects.status: Early development. The maintainer README warns that behavior and public APIs may change substantially. It describes ahead-of-time C++ generation and publishes stable and nightly SDK builds, but gives no general title-compatibility guarantee.
projects.summary: An Xbox 360 static recompilation SDK that converts PowerPC code to C++ ahead of time and supplies a shared native runtime. The maintainer describes it as based on Xenia research and related static recompiler work; it is not an emulator.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; original game data is supplied by the user

projects.title: ReXAuto — Xbox 360 Recompilation Pipeline and Launcher
projects.platform: Xbox 360 → Windows x86-64; an optional GitHub Actions workflow produces native Android arm64 APKs
projects.status: Work in progress. The maintainer lists per-title milestones and documents an automated pipeline that can reach a booting, guest-code-executing build. The README warns that graphics and kernel gaps in ReXGlue can still prevent a title from drawing correctly or staying up. Its Android APK workflow uses an Android patch set and is not a universal compatibility guarantee.
projects.summary: A desktop front end and orchestration pipeline for ReXGlue, not a separate CPU recompiler or emulator. It extracts game containers, scaffolds projects, recovers jump tables, repairs function boundaries, builds and launches per-title Windows ports, and documents an optional native Android arm64 build workflow. Game files are user-supplied.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation workflow and launcher using ReXGlue
projects.source_available: Public source repository; original game data is supplied by the user
projects.subtype: Recompilation orchestration; Windows and Android build workflows

projects.status: Work in progress. The maintainer README documents a build-and-diff workflow using a user-provided XEX, Python, Ninja, and objdiff. It does not report a completion percentage, release, or playable PC port.

projects.title: TerrariaOGC — Old-Gen Console Decompilation and Windows Port
projects.platform: Xbox 360 / PlayStation 3 Old-Gen console version → Windows
projects.status: A functional Windows port based on the console decompilation. The maintainer says the initial console release and version 1.01 are available; console versions 1.03 and 1.09 are planned but not yet available. The README does not document direct support for non-Windows hosts. Users provide their own console game assets.
projects.summary: A decompilation-based PC port of the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 Old-Gen Terraria release, with Windows/FNA build instructions and enhancements over the console version. It is a separate project from the catalogued TerrariaXDK decompilation and requires user-supplied game data.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game assets are user-supplied and not distributed

projects.title: Project Gracemeria — Ace Combat 6 Xenon Game Module
projects.platform: Xbox 360 USA retail TU0 → Project Xenon generated native game module; host support follows Xenon's evolving runtime
projects.status: Early title-specific module and tooling. The maintainer documents a USA retail TU0 profile and commands to generate a Xenon game module from a user-supplied XEX, but makes no in-game compatibility or playability claim for Ace Combat 6 in this repository. The exact effective-XEX hash and version are intentionally left for real-title validation.
projects.summary: A title-specific module for the separate Project Xenon Xbox 360 recompilation runtime. It supplies Ace Combat 6 revision identity, analysis hints, symbols, and compatibility metadata; it is not a second runtime or a standalone game port. It migrated some configuration and analysis metadata from the existing ReXGlue-based AC6_recomp project.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation through Project Xenon title module
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game XEX is user-supplied and not distributed
projects.subtype: Xbox 360 title-specific recompilation module and metadata tools

projects.title: Monster Hunter (Japanese PS2) Decompilation and PC/Original Xbox Port
projects.platform: Japanese PlayStation 2 → Linux x86, Windows x86, Original Xbox (nxdk)
projects.status: Work in progress. The maintainer's current playing guide reports the full single-player game playable and documents Linux, Windows, and Original Xbox builds; the Original Xbox build was tested on one console and in xemu. The October 8 Windows test release is explicitly untested on a real Windows PC (the maintainer reports its full test set passes under Wine). Rough edges remain.
projects.summary: A matching decompilation of the Japanese PS2 release retargeted to Linux, Windows, and Original Xbox. The build uses user-supplied disc data and the open nxdk toolchain for Xbox; no Capcom game data is included. The same repository separately builds Monster Hunter G.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; PS2 disc and game data are user-supplied and not distributed
projects.subtype: Matching decompilation; Linux, Windows, and Original Xbox port

projects.title: Monster Hunter G (Japanese PS2) Decompilation and PC/Original Xbox Port
projects.platform: Japanese PlayStation 2 → Linux x86, Windows x86, Original Xbox (nxdk)
projects.status: Work in progress. The maintainer's guide says the same build commands accept a Monster Hunter G disc and produce Linux, Windows, and Original Xbox builds; it states the whole single-player game is playable across the project, but gives no separate Original Xbox hardware test result for G. The October 8 Windows test release is for the base Monster Hunter title, not a separately listed G package. The guide says G has no online mode.
projects.summary: A matching decompilation of the Japanese PS2 Monster Hunter G release, retargeted to Linux, Windows, and Original Xbox using the same project repository and toolchain as the base game. Users supply their own disc data; none is distributed.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; PS2 disc and game data are user-supplied and not distributed
projects.subtype: Matching decompilation; Linux, Windows, and Original Xbox port
